Preserve its narrow crown width-to-height ratio, tapered top, gently irregular outline and trunk-to-crown proportion precisely. This is NOT a conifer, not a rounded spreading tree, not a palm. Natural continuous organic branches and individual fine leaves with restrained detail; do not reproduce pixel blocks. Hidden branches are conservative inference. Match original silhouette when uniformly reduced to about 34 by 80 pixels.

Low pale concrete 2x2 footprint, compact industrial trapezoid bunker walls, red player-color trim around upper rim, red panels/emblems on pedestal, small dark entrance and structural recesses as visibly observed. Natural continuous modeled metal/stone surfaces, restrained bevels and joints, believable roughness, no pixel block steps and no toy plastic. Keep team-red strictly confined to observed pedestal trim and panels, statue remains unpainted silver metal. Full building with modest margins, identical original viewing angle, dark neutral charcoal background, no cast shadow, no scenery, no added text. Hidden back geometry is conservative inference.
